differences.justification: AbstractElasticsearchEmbeddingStore.fullTextSearchMatches() returns EmbeddingMatch, the same core type already returned by search() and hybridSearch() via EmbeddingSearchResult

Elasticsearch SDK enum intentionally exposed by Builder.refresh(Refresh) and the constructor to configure bulk write refresh behavior. The integration already depends on the Elasticsearch SDK; existing constructor signatures and the default Refresh.False behavior are preserved.
